parts: [{"label":"a","letter":"a","text":"What is Hajj?","marks":1,"answer":"The visit to Baitullah (Kaba, House of Allah) and the places connected thereto on the fixed days in the fixed method in the month of Zil Hajj with the intention of pleasing Allah is called Hajj.","image":null,"image_url":null},{"label":"b","letter":"b","text":"\"Pay the worker before his sweat dries\". Explain it.","marks":2,"answer":"Wages are the right of workers and hence must be paid on time. In Islam, no one's work is belittled. Everyone's work is valued. Islam does not approve of any discrimination between the master and the worker in respect of every matter, including food, dress, etc. It is ruled in Islam to behave well with the worker and give wages with fairness and on time. For this reason, Prophet (Sm.) says, \"Pay the worker his dues before his sweat dries out.\" (Ibn Majah)","image":null,"image_url":null},{"label":"c","letter":"c","text":"Explain the teachings of the Sura to which Akbar Ali's actions correspond.","marks":3,"answer":"Akbar Ali's actions are similar to the Kafir and Munafigs mentioned in Sura Al-Maun. Kafirs and Munafigs are great enemies of Islam. They show duplicity to fool Muslims. Also, they are reluctant to help human beings. Such behaviors are mentioned in Sura Al-Maun. These are also visible in Akbar. Akbar always talks about Islam. However, he does not perform Salat on time. Besides, he does not lend his neighbours his household items. Such an act is similar to the Kafirs and Munafigs stated in Sura Al-Maun. In this Sura, we have numerous teachings for us. For example, it is Kafirs and Munafigs who disbelieve in the Day of Judgment. It is not permissible. The orphans and distressed are not to be warded off; rather, they should be helped and supported as far as possible. All members of one's family—kith and kin, friends and comrades, neighbors—should be encouraged to help. Besides, Salat cannot be neglected. It should not be intended for making a show. Rather, Salat should be performed with the purest intention only for the pleasure of Allah the Most High. Because when a person shows indifference to Salat, there awaits perdition. Therefore, it can be said that Akbar Ali's activities are portrayed in Sura Al-Maun.","image":null,"image_url":null},{"label":"d","letter":"d","text":"Analyze Noman's teachings by identifying which Sura's teachings are reflected in his actions.","marks":4,"answer":"In Noman Miah's actions, the teachings of Sura Al-Inshirah are reflected. Upon receiving prophethood, Rasulullah (Sm.) began to preach Islam among the Arabs. They tried a number of ways to resist him. They continued to oppose him. As a result, the Muslims became extremely irritated by their oppression and torture. In such circumstances, Sura Al-Inshirah was revealed as a consolation. In this Sura, Allah the Most High says, “Certainly with hardship goes comfort”. This ayat was revealed to console the Prophet (Sm.) when he was facing severe hardships from the non-believers. Noman Miah, despite being in financial hardship, devotes himself to worship and believes in the relief after suffering. This belief and practice directly reflect the core teaching of Sura Al-Inshirah – that with every difficulty, Allah provides ease, and one should remain patient and steadfast in worship.","image":null,"image_url":null}]

parts: [{"label":"a","letter":"a","text":"What is Shariat?","marks":1,"answer":"Shariat is such a clear and distinct path by following which man can safely and gracefully reach his own destination.","image":null,"image_url":null},{"label":"b","letter":"b","text":"Explain the importance of reciting the Quran.","marks":2,"answer":"To attain success both in this life and hereafter and to lead one's life on the correct path, reciting the Quran is essential. Al Quran is the sacred sayings of Allah. This is the complete storehouse of knowledge. Correct guidance of all aspects of human lives has been given in the Quran. It is the best form of Ibadat. Reciting one of its letters brings in a ten-fold reward. The Quran enhances the dignity of the reciter. For these reasons, reciting the Quran is immensely important.","image":null,"image_url":null},{"label":"c","letter":"c","text":"The teaching of which sura has been violated by the activities of Mr. Sajid? Explain it.","marks":3,"answer":"The activities of Mr. Sajid violated the teachings of Sura Al-Maun. Sura Al Maun described the features and activities of the Kafirs and the Munafiqs and asked men to avoid them. Sajid didn't follow this teaching. Mr. Sajid is indifferent towards saying his prayers. He also chases away the orphaned beggars who request him for alms. But in Sura Maun, we can see that this is the activity of the Kafir and the Munafiqs to chase away the orphans and be rude to them rather than extend a helping hand towards them. Another feature of the Munafiq is that they do not say their prayers regularly. They are indifferent towards Salat. For these activities, there will be destruction in Akhirat. That's why rather than chasing away the destitute and the orphans, they must be helped. Salat can never be neglected. Thus we can see that the activities of Mr. Sajid violated the teachings of the sura Al-Maun.","image":null,"image_url":null},{"label":"d","letter":"d","text":"Mentioning the Sura whose teaching has been reflected in Mr. Aman's speech, analyse his last statement.","marks":4,"answer":"The statement of Mr. Aman reflected the teachings of Sura Al-Inshirah. Sura Al-Inshirah is the 94th Sura of Al-Quran. In this Sura, Allah described his rewards for the Prophet (Sm.). Allah has also instructed the prophet what to do in times of crisis. Mr. Aman's statement supports these. Mr. Aman asks his neighbours to have patience in times of distress. According to him there will be ups and downs in life and the truth of this statement can be seen in Sura Al-Inshirah. When the Prophet started preaching Islam among the Arabs, the Kafirs started protesting against him. The prophet and the new Muslims were tortured. This distressed the prophet. In this situation Allah consoled the prophet and said, after sorrow, there will be happiness. As sadness will always be there, we can't be frustrated. Rather we have to deal with it with patience. That's why rather than becoming distressed in the face of hardship, one must concentrate on worshipping Allah. From the above discussion, it can be understood that the statement of Aman was influenced by the teaching of sura Al-Inshirah. His last statement in this regard is accurate.","image":null,"image_url":null}]

Allah has described some characteristics of Munafiqs in it and encouraged in helping orphans, destitutes, needy. Alongside, He also forbade to pray for showing others. All of which are observed in the character of Mr. M. In the stem he behaves kindly with orphans, poors and relatives with the expectations of reward in Akhirat. Haram is opposite to Halal. Those actions or things which Allah the Most High and His Rasul (Sm) have clearly forbidden—all those are Haram for man. For instance, usury, bribery, gambling, eating pig meat, drinking wine etc. And the money earning through these Haram things are also considered as haram earning which is noticeable in the earnings of Mr. 'N'. Mr. 'N' of the stem earned a lot of money by doing business of narcotics and leads a luxurious life. After learning about his earnings, respected Imam said, \"The consequences of this type of earnings are very horrible in here and here after life\". Here, the statement of the Imam regarding haram earning is proper. Haram activities exert harmful influence on human society. Due to this, social environment deteriorates, moral, human value are destroyed.; disparity surfaces in the society. And those who are engaged in such Haram activities, are hated by all in the society. Alongside this, there is frightening consequences for them in the life hereafter. Rasul (Sm) said, \"That body (human) which is formed on Haram, will be the fuel of Hell\" (Ahmad, Baihadj and Darimi). Lastly, it can be said that, for earning through Haram objects, the earnings of Mr. 'N' is haram. And the statement of the respected Imam about this is accurate.","image":null,"image_url":null}]

parts: [{"label":"a","letter":"a","text":"What is 'Shan-i-Nuzul'?","marks":1,"answer":"The cause or background of the revelation of the Sura or Ayat of Al-Quran is called 'Shan-i-Nuzul'.","image":null,"image_url":null},{"label":"b","letter":"b","text":"Why is Hazrat Usman called 'Jamiul Quran'? Explain.","marks":2,"answer":"Hazrat Uthman (Ra.) is called Jamiul Quran for fulfilling the responsibility of compiling the Quran. There arose some differences in the recitation of Al-Quran during the Khilafat of Hazrat Uthman (Ra.). For this, there was a chance of confusion. Realizing this matter, he collected copies of different tribal styles, kept the pure one and burned the other copies in agreement with other Sahabis. In this way, Al-Quran was compiled under his direct supervision. For this great and noble contribution, Hazrat Uthman (Ra.) is called 'Jamiul Quran' or 'Gatherer' or 'Compiler' of Al-Quran.","image":null,"image_url":null},{"label":"c","letter":"c","text":"Tabassum's comment is related to which sura of your textbook? Explain the teaching of that sura.","marks":3,"answer":"Tabassum's comment is related to the Sura At-Tin in the textbook. Similar to the Creative Question-Answer No. 6(c). Complete Answer from text: Tabassum's comment is related to the Sura At-Tin in the textbook. Sura At-Tin is the 95th Sura of the Holy Quran. In this Sura, Allah declares that He has created human beings in the best of forms (the finest stature). Tabassum's statement that \"Allah has created human beings with the nice structure\" directly reflects the message of verse 4 of this Sura. The teaching of Sura At-Tin is that while Allah has honoured humans with the best physical and spiritual form, this honour is contingent upon faith and righteous deeds. If humans neglect Allah's commands and engage in evil, they will be degraded to the lowest of the low, both in this world and the hereafter. Thus, the Sura connects physical perfection with moral and spiritual responsibility.","image":null,"image_url":null},{"label":"d","letter":"d","text":"Sultana's activities are similar to the subject matter of which sura of your textbook? Identify it and explain its significance.","marks":4,"answer":"Sultana's activities are similar to the subject matter of Sura Al-Maun of the textbook. Sura Al-Maun describes the characteristics of the hypocrites (Munafiqun). One of these characteristics is refusing to give even small acts of kindness or lending household items to those in need. Sultana, despite fulfilling her core family duties, refuses to help neighbours with household necessities. This behaviour mirrors the attitude condemned in Sura Al-Maun. The significance of this Sura is that it exposes the hypocrisy of those who may perform some religious or social duties but lack basic compassion and refuse minor assistance to others. It teaches that true faith is reflected in generosity, especially in small, everyday matters, and that miserliness in these areas is a sign of hypocrisy that leads to divine punishment.","image":null,"image_url":null}]

parts: [{"label":"a","letter":"a","text":"Define Sunnah?","marks":1,"answer":"The sayings, deeds, practices, traditions as well as conventions approved by the holy Prophet (Sm) are called the Sunnah.","image":null,"image_url":null},{"label":"b","letter":"b","text":"Why is the 3rd Hijri century called the Golden Age of Hadith compilation? Explain.","marks":2,"answer":"In the third Hijri century, many Hadith books were compiled. Hence, this century is called the golden era of Hadith compilation. The sayings, deeds and tacit approvals of Prophet (Sm) are called Hadith. The preservation of Hadith began in Rasulullah’s (Sm) life time but collective compilation of Hadith did not start. During the Umayyad Khilafat, Hazrat Umar Ibn Abdul Aziz (Ra) first took the initiatives to compile Hadiths. Later in the third Hijri century, the six most authentic books of Hadith were compiled. These are collectively called ‘Al-Sihah-Al Sittah’ or the six authentic Hadith books. As these main books of Hadiths were compiled in the third Hijri century, this century is called golden era of Hadith compilation.","image":null,"image_url":null},{"label":"c","letter":"c","text":"Which Hadith in the textbook is related to the activities of Mr. Akram? Explain","marks":3,"answer":"The Hadith on plantation of textbook is related with the activities of Mr. Akram. Similar to the Creative Question-Answer No. 7(c). Complete Answer from text: The Hadith on plantation of textbook is related with the activities of Mr. Akram. In the Hadith related to plantation, the Holy Prophet (Sm) said, \"If a Muslim plants a sapling (tree) or grows any crop, and if some birds, men or animals eat a portion from that, then it will be counted as charity on his behalf\" (Bukhari and Muslim).
